Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 31

“Those who eat the nectar of what remains from sacrifice go to the eternal Brahman. This world is not for one who does not sacrifice — how then the next, best of the Kurus?”

The remainder returns from Chapter 3, now called nectar. And the warning sharpens: the non-offerer does not even manage this world well, let alone anything beyond it.
